{{Youmay|the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of [[Oorn Noth]]|the [[ZH-25 Questor-class light freighter|ZH-25 ''Questor''-class light freighter]] [[Last Laugh (ZH-25 Questor-class)|''Last Laugh'']] of [[Myra Joraan]]}}
The '''''Last Laugh''''' was the personal starship of [[Oorn Noth]]. Noth used the ship for racing purposes as well as occasional smuggling jobs.
